name: Putiel
title: Father-in-law of Eleazar
summary: Putiel is a biblical figure mentioned only once in Scripture, in Exodus 6:25. He is known as the father of the woman who married Eleazar, Aaron's son. Through this marriage, he became the grandfather of Phinehas, who played an important role in Israel's priesthood.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Aaron's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Putiel is mentioned in connection with the listing of Levi's descendants, where it is stated that his daughter married Eleazar, Aaron's son.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Eleazar
keyEvents.description: Putiel's daughter married Eleazar, who was the son of Aaron and succeeded his father as high priest.

keyEvents.title: Grandfather of Phinehas
keyEvents.description: Through the marriage of his daughter to Eleazar, Putiel became the grandfather of Phinehas, who was known for his zeal for the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Phinehas' Zeal at Peor
keyEvents.description: Putiel's grandson Phinehas showed great zeal for God at Baal-Peor and received an eternal priesthood covenant, demonstrating the significant priestly line to which Putiel was connected.
